more_info.overview: Indanthrene Blue RS is an anthraquinone-derived organic pigment also identified as C.I. Vat Blue 4. Its colouring function is to add or restore colour in the food. The available identity record does not establish a typical retail-food example for this exact preparation. Commercial specifications and legal conditions need to refer to the particular substance or preparation named here.
